convert_torch_script: convert a PyTorch model to a TorchScript traced model with optional batch norm fusion and output verification
save_model: save a TorchScript traced model to a directory as model.jit with optional data
convert_int8_jit: convert a PyTorch model to an INT8 quantized TorchScript model with a configurable quantization backend
review_convert_torch_script: review the convert_torch_script function to understand batch norm fusion and tracing behavior
test_convert_int8_jit: test the convert_int8_jit function to verify INT8 quantization produces correct outputs
